summary: Implements floating-point exponentiation (x87 FYL2X based) with full IEEE 754 edge-case handling. Validates an argument marker, special-cases NaN/infinity and zero operands, dispatches the finite-base finite-exponent case to sub_58DE2C under an fsave/frstor FPU-state save, runs X87FPExponentiation over __FYL2X__ for the general negative-base case, and raises a math-error report through the handler at 0x005E63B8 or the default wrapper when the flag dword_8D3E40 is clear.

operations.description: Validate the argument marker: when the low word of a1 is not 639, call sub_58DCB5 (invalid-argument handling).
Inspect the exponent bits of a1 with mask 0x7FF00000; equality with 2146435072 selects the NaN/infinity path for the first operand.
Load the NaN/infinity branch operand through FloadWithFBFloatLoadWithNaNCheck.
When the second operand is finite or an unqualified zero, dispatch to sub_58DE2C around an fsave/frstor FPU-state save/restore.
The NaN/infinity with finite exponent path returns the sum of the loaded value and the second operand.
For a non-special first operand, reload it via FloadWithFBFloatLoadWithNaNCheck and branch on the zero-flag result v10.
When the exponent operand has nonzero mantissa or exponent bits (not a pure zero), take the exponentiation path.
Negative base with non-integer exponent: call FloatRoundednessCheck and negate the second operand before exponentiating.
Core computation: X87FPExponentiation of __FYL2X__(second operand, base), negated when the sign-bit flag v12 is set.
When the math-error handling flag dword_8D3E40 is clear, raise a domain/exception report through the handler at 0x005E63B8 (called as sub_58DD89 in the raw source).
When the exponent operand is a pure zero (no mantissa or exponent bits), return 1.0 when the mantissa is also zero and 0.0 otherwise.
The zero/infinity-result cases are materialized from the 80-bit constants tbyte_5E6BF0 and tbyte_5E6C50, with sign applied from the v17/v18 sign bits.
On exceptional return paths, when dword_8D3E40 is clear, CRTFloatPassthroughWrapper applies the default error return.
Return the computed double result in ST0 (result/result variable).
